hero.eyebrow: Day trips, activities & transfers from Agadir
hero.h1: What kind of day do you want?
hero.lede: Quads on the dunes, camels by the Souss river, Marrakech or Essaouira for the day, the airport run at the end of your holiday. Tell us the day you have in mind. We probably know what to do — with pickup from your hotel on almost every trip.
hero.note: Twenty-odd kinds of day. One desk.

guide.title: Seven moods, twenty-four days out of Agadir
guide.none_here: Nothing that length in this mood — try another, or ask us.
guide.all_link: See all 24 days on one page

sand.name: Sand & engines
sand.intro: South of Agadir the tracks run through Berber villages and out onto dunes by the ocean at Tifnit. Bring sunglasses; you'll get sand everywhere.
sand.note: Quads, a sandboard and a camel in one afternoon? Ask us — we combine.
sand.title: Quads, buggies, sandboarding & the Little Desert from Agadir
sand.desc: Sand & engines: quad biking to the dunes by Tifnit beach, two-seat buggies, sandboarding and the Little Desert by 4x4. Hotel pickup from Agadir. Ask for today's price.

salt.name: Salt water
salt.intro: Agadir lives on its bay. Get on it, get in it, or follow the coast south for a long day by the sea.
salt.page_note: Calm mornings are the best for anything on the water.
salt.title: Jet ski, boat trips, surf lessons & Legzira from Agadir
salt.desc: Salt water: a jet ski on Agadir bay, a boat trip with fishing and fish grilled on board, surf lessons with hotel pickup, and the long coastal day to Legzira.

hooves.name: Hooves, humps & crocodiles
hooves.intro: Camels and horses out to the Souss river, where flamingos feed in the shallows. And for the kids, a park full of Nile crocodiles.
hooves.title: Camel rides, horse riding & Crocoparc from Agadir
hooves.desc: Camel rides by the Souss river and its flamingos, camel and barbecue dinner, horse riding through the eucalyptus woods, and Crocoparc. Hotel pickup from Agadir.

medina.name: Medinas & markets
medina.intro: Ramparts, souks and big old squares: Marrakech and Essaouira for the day, or Agadir's own port and Souk El Had in a morning.
medina.note: Marrakech is a long one: out at 7, home around 9.
medina.title: Marrakech, Essaouira & Agadir city tour — day trips from Agadir
medina.desc: Medinas & markets: Marrakech for the day, Essaouira's ramparts and port with a guide, and a three-hour Agadir city tour with Souk El Had. Hotel pickup.

valleys.name: Palms, gorges & mountain villages
valleys.intro: Inland the air changes. Palm-lined gorges up the Imouzzer road, the walls of Taroudant, granite villages around Tafraout.
valleys.note: In summer we go to Paradise Valley in the morning. The afternoons are scorching.
valleys.title: Paradise Valley, Taroudant & Tafraout — day trips from Agadir
valleys.desc: Palms, gorges & mountain villages: Paradise Valley on the Imouzzer road, Taroudant's ramparts and the Tiout palm grove, and Tafraout's painted rocks on request.

slow.name: Go slow
slow.intro: Not every day needs an engine. Steam and argan oil, a long dinner with music, a balloon at sunrise if the dates work.
slow.page_note: Hammam the day after Marrakech. Trust us.
slow.title: Hammam, Berber evening & sunrise balloon — slow days in Agadir
slow.desc: Go slow: a traditional hammam with argan oil massage and transport, a Berber evening with dinner and fantasia, and a sunrise balloon flight on request.

further.name: Two days, one night away
further.intro: Sleep in the desert at Zagora or El Borj, or do Marrakech and Essaouira together. These run on request — message us for dates.
further.page_note: Tell us your dates first. We'll tell you honestly what's possible.
further.title: Two-day trips from Agadir — Zagora, El Borj, Marrakech & Essaouira
further.desc: Two days, one night away, on request: the Zagora desert via the Draa valley, the El Borj dunes, or Marrakech and Essaouira together. Message us for dates.

visit_page.title: Visit the desk — Hala Tours Agadir at the Hotel Hamilton
visit_page.desc: Find the Hala Tours Agadir desk inside the Hotel Hamilton, Boulevard Mohammed V, Agadir. Open Monday–Saturday 08:00–23:00, Sunday 09:00–22:00. Map, directions, WhatsApp.
visit_page.h1: Come and see us at the Hamilton
visit_page.lede: A real desk in a real hotel. Walk in, sit down, tell us what you fancy — or message us first and we'll have ideas ready.
find: We're inside the Hotel Hamilton on Boulevard Mohammed V, in the centre of Agadir.
Come in through the hotel's main entrance. Can't see us straight away? Ask at reception.
Staying at another hotel? That's fine — on almost every trip we collect you from your hotel in Agadir.
getting: Agadir–Al Massira airport is about 23 km away — around 30 minutes by road. We can collect you.
There's a city bus stop about 200 m from the hotel.
Ask for the Hotel Hamilton on Boulevard Mohammed V.
visit_page.team: Most people meet Ayoub at the desk. Tell him what you like, how long you've got and who's coming, and you'll get an honest answer — including which days aren't worth it for small children.
